nodes.title: IA-automorphism group of a free group is not linear

nodes.summary: The statement that for some $n \ge 3$ the group $\mathrm{IA}(F_n)$ of automorphisms of the free group $F_n$ on $n$ generators that act trivially on its abelianization $F_n/[F_n, F_n]$ is linear, that is, there are a field $K$, a natural number $m$ and an injective group homomorphism $\mathrm{IA}(F_n) \to \mathrm{GL}_m(K)$.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 15.10 (statement): linearity of IA-automorphism groups of free groups

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, let $F_n$ be the free group on $n$ generators. $\mathrm{IA}(F_n)$ is the subgroup of the automorphism group of $F_n$ consisting of the automorphisms $\varphi$ that act trivially on the abelianization $F_n/[F_n, F_n]$, that is, such that $\varphi(x)$ and $x$ have the same image in $F_n/[F_n, F_n]$ for every $x \in F_n$.
